explanation: Kimura (arXiv:2304.03956, abstract) proves 'the Auslander–Reiten conjecture holds true for every normal ring'. The formal statement specialises to Noetherian integrally closed domains (normal domains), a special case of normal rings, with the same Ext hypotheses and projective conclusion as the commutative variant. The docstring explains the restriction. A correct, slightly weaker, instance of the cited result. Faithful.
